title: A site owns the whole text of its agents' role instructions
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-1cc24f.

The role text in `newsroom_context_pack.py` and the outline, draft and idea instructions assume evidence-first news and can only be added to. A site must be able to replace them. This reverses the add-only decision of 2026-11-08 (Ryan, 2026-11-11). Related: PPY-7a61ca.
